description: Measured on bd3edae98: a walk that builds <<c>> from each matched byte costs 1 scalar_box + 1 bitstring per byte on interp and AOT alike (scratchpad b.fz). Per the fz-9x7 owner, the box predates fz-9x7 and comes from scalars handed out as values at an extern boundary (box_scalar_for_any, runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs:281-308). The escape decode boxes 6 per escape on AOT (1 on interp). Closing proves: scalar_box 0 on the copy probe. Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-json-garbage.html (approved 2026-11-14). Worktree ../fz-json, base bd3edae98.
title: Building <<c>> from an integer boxes no integer
